zh: 航空安全彙整：Fedex MD-11邁阿密落地衝出跑道等3起事件
en: Safety roundup: Fedex MD-11 runway overrun in Miami among three independent incidents.

zh: 公開 ADS-B 觀測到中國東方航空 A330-300 抵達桃園；本站過去180天未記錄相同組合。
en: China Eastern Airlines' A330-300 was observed arriving at Taoyuan; the site had no matching operator, type and airport combination in 180 days.

zh: 民航局：選舉期間離島部分航班近滿訂
en: Taiwan CAA says some island flights are nearly booked during the election period.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：Plus Ultra 暫停最後航線、聯合航空格陵蘭航班載客率僅46% 需求受限、英國皇家空軍據報夜間將軍機移入遮蔽處 防範潛在無人機威脅
en: Aviation briefs: Plus Ultra suspends final route; United Airlines' Greenland Flights Only 46% Full, Demand Limited; British Royal Air Force reportedly shelters aircraft overnight amid possible drone threat

zh: Fedex飛機在邁阿密降落時滑出跑道；另有5起獨立事件
en: A Fedex aircraft overran a runway on landing at Miami; five other independent incidents were reported.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：芝加哥奧黑爾機場（ORD）設備故障一度延誤到港航班　FAA 已解除地面管制、歐盟航空安全總署改版EASA Pro首頁 個人化新聞改設專區、美國航空與 Israir 簽合作協議，規劃 2027 年恢復紐約至特拉維夫航班
en: Aviation briefs: FAA lifts ground restrictions at Chicago O’Hare after equipment outage delays arrivals; EASA redesigns EASA Pro homepage, gives personalised news its own area; American and Israir sign partnership ahead of planned JFK–Tel Aviv resumption

zh: 聯邦快遞航機降落時衝出跑道；另有5起獨立事件
en: FedEx aircraft overran a runway in Miami; five other incidents are separate.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：馬來西亞航空集團承諾採購 10 架波音 787-10，另有 6 架選擇權、易捷航空全年稅後獲利年減96% 執行長指中東衝突使航空業面臨挑戰、挪威Norse Atlantic航空財務告急：須取得融資才能維持營運
en: Aviation briefs: Malaysia Aviation Group commits to 10 Boeing 787-10s with options for six more; EasyJet annual after-tax profit falls 96%; CEO cites challenges from Middle East conflict; Norse Atlantic Airways says its financial situation is critical, needs funding to keep flying

zh: Norse Atlantic暫停航班並警告可能聲請破產
en: Norse Atlantic suspends flights and warns of possible bankruptcy.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：美國航空籌辦珍珠港事件 85 週年紀念包機、ACI 公布機場創新獎，上海浦東與虹橋分獲兩項肯定、日本松山機場舉行空難應變演練
en: Aviation briefs: American Airlines plans Pearl Harbor anniversary charter; ACI names airport innovation winners, with awards for Shanghai Pudong and Hongqiao; Japan’s Matsuyama Airport holds aircraft emergency drill
